patches.title: Skip Initial Look
patches.principle: At the start, do not use the look action; immediately navigate to a common surface like countertop1.
patches.when_to_apply: When beginning a task and the room description is provided.

patches.title: Direct Post-Clean Delivery
patches.principle: After cleaning an object, go straight to the destination and place it without any intermediate stops.
patches.when_to_apply: When the object has just been cleaned and the target location is known.

patches.title: Return to Source After First Placement
patches.principle: After placing the first object, immediately return to the location where it was found to search for the second.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing two objects and the first has just been placed.
